Kevin Durant and T.J. Warren were acquired by the Phoenix Suns in exchange for Mikal Bridges, Jae Crowder, Cameron Johnson, a 2023 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2025 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2027 1st round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2028 1st round picks and a 2029 1st round pick (PHX own). George Hill, Serge Ibaka, Jordan Nwora, a More Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a 2024 2nd round pick (MIL own), a 2025 2nd round pick (IND own) and cash were acquired by the Indiana Pacers in exchange for the draft rights to Juan Vaulet. Mikal Bridges, Cameron Johnson, the draft rights to Juan Vaulet, a 2023 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2025 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2027 1st round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2028 1st round picks, a 2028 2nd round pick (MIL own), a 2029 1st round pick (PHX own), a 2029 2nd round pick (MIL own) and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Brooklyn Nets in exchange for Kevin Durant, T.J. Warren and cash.

moves.label: Trade: Bradley Beal, Jordan Goodwin, Isaiah Todd, Chris Paul, Landry Shamet and others
moves.description: Bradley Beal, Jordan Goodwin and Isaiah Todd were acquired by the Phoenix Suns in exchange for Chris Paul, Landry Shamet, a Swap 2028 1st round picks, a Swap 2024 1st round picks, a 2024 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2025 2nd round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2026 1st round picks, a 2026 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2027 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2028 2nd round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2030 1st round picks, a 2030 2nd round pick (PHX own) and cash. The draft rights to Jarace Walker, a 2028 2nd round pick (PHX own) and a 2029 2nd round pick (WAS own) were acquired by the Indiana Pacers in exchange for the draft rights to Bilal Coulibaly. Chris Paul, Landry Shamet, the draft rights to Bilal Coulibaly, a Swap 2028 1st round picks, a Swap 2024 1st round picks, a 2024 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2025 2nd round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2026 1st round picks, a 2026 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2027 2nd round pick (PHX own), a Swap 2030 1st round picks, a 2030 2nd round pick (PHX own), cash and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for Bradley Beal, Jordan Goodwin, Isaiah Todd, the draft rights to Jarace Walker, a 2029 2nd round pick (WAS own) and a TPE.

Deandre Ayton, Toumani Camara, Jrue Holiday, a Swap 2028 1st round picks, a 2029 1st round pick (MIL own), a Swap 2030 1st round picks and a TPE were acquired by the Portland Trail Blazers in exchange for Keon Johnson, Damian Lillard, Nassir Little, Jusuf Nurkic and a TPE.

moves.description: Royce O'Neale and David Roddy were acquired by the Phoenix Suns in exchange for Keita Bates-Diop, Jordan Goodwin, Chimezie Metu, Yuta Watanabe, a Swap 2026 1st round picks, a Least Favorable 2026 2nd round pick, a 2028 2nd round pick (MEM own), a 2029 2nd round pick (MEM own) and a TPE. Chimezie Metu, Yuta Watanabe, a Swap 2026 1st round picks and a TPE were acquired by the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for David Roddy and the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic. Keita Bates-Diop, Jordan Goodwin, the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic, a Least Favorable 2026 2nd round pick, a 2028 2nd round pick (MEM own), a 2029 2nd round pick (MEM own) and a TPE were acquired by the Brooklyn Nets in exchange for Royce O'Neale and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Adou Thiero, Adou Thiero, Rocco Zikarsky, Jahmai Mashack, Alex Toohey and others
moves.description: A 2030 2nd round pick (BOS own) was acquired by the Brooklyn Nets in exchange for the draft rights to Adou Thiero and a Swap 2026 2nd round picks. The draft rights to Adou Thiero was acquired by the Los Angeles Lakers in exchange for the draft rights to Rocco Zikarsky and cash. The draft rights to Jahmai Mashack and the draft rights to Alex Toohey were acquired by the Golden State Warriors in exchange for the draft rights to Koby Brea. Clint Capela, Kevin Durant and a Swap 2026 2nd round picks were acquired by the Houston Rockets in exchange for Dillon Brooks, Jalen Green, the draft rights to Khaman Maluach, the draft rights to Jahmai Mashack, a More Favorable 2026 2nd round pick, a 2030 2nd round pick (BOS own), a Swap 2031 2nd round picks, a 2032 2nd round pick (HOU own) and cash. A Swap 2031 2nd round picks, cash and a TPE were acquired by the Atlanta Hawks in exchange for Clint Capela. The draft rights to Rocco Zikarsky, a Least Favorable 2026 2nd round pick, a More Favorable 2032 2nd round pick and cash were acquired by the Minnesota Timberwolves in exchange for the draft rights to Rasheer Fleming. Dillon Brooks, Jalen Green, the draft rights to Koby Brea, the draft rights to Rasheer Fleming, the draft rights to Khaman Maluach, a More Favorable 2026 2nd round pick and a 2032 2nd round pick (HOU own) were acquired by the Phoenix Suns in exchange for Kevin Durant, the draft rights to Alex Toohey, a Least Favorable 2026 2nd round pick and a More Favorable 2032 2nd round pick.

moves.description: The draft rights to Koa Peat was acquired by the Phoenix Suns in exchange for a More Favorable 2026 2nd round pick, a 2029 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2033 2nd round pick (PHX own) and cash. The draft rights to Sergio De Larrea was acquired by the Dallas Mavericks in exchange for the draft rights to Melvin Ajinca, the draft rights to Koa Peat, a 2030 2nd round pick (PHL own) and a 2032 2nd round pick (DAL own). The draft rights to Cameron Carr was acquired by the Los Angeles Lakers in exchange for the draft rights to Sergio De Larrea, the draft rights to Chinemelu Elonu, the draft rights to Louis Labeyrie and cash. The draft rights to Melvin Ajinca, the draft rights to Chinemelu Elonu, the draft rights to Louis Labeyrie, a More Favorable 2026 2nd round pick, a 2029 2nd round pick (PHX own), a 2030 2nd round pick (PHL own), a 2032 2nd round pick (DAL own), a 2033 2nd round pick (PHX own) and cash were acquired by the New York Knicks in exchange for the draft rights to Cameron Carr.

For2030andlater, continue the latest announced lottery system; the NBA has not yet determined those rules.
Reported most-favorable DET-held2028right, top55protected; physicalDET56–60is already owedPHI and is never reassigned.
Top-N second-round protections use actual overall numbers, including a second-round selection atNo.30 after a first-round forfeiture.
Reconstructed career-path pick prices use the fixed current endpoint-trained model and the last archived strength/standings forecast dated 2026-09-30; legal rights are dated 2026-09-30.
Historical injury coverage uses reviewed major absence reports; it is not a complete archive of short-term medical reports.
